import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Clean Sleep Disorder column
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Extract systolic blood pressure
df['Systolic BP'] = df['Blood Pressure'].apply(lambda x: int(x.split('/')[0]))

# Set up the figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette
palette = sns.color_palette("husl", 4)

# 1. Sleep Duration by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.barplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', ax=ax1, palette='coolwarm')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration by BMI Category')
ax1.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_xlabel('BMI Category')

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs Physical Activity
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                       c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlGn_r', s=100, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Physical Activity')
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Stress Level')

# 3. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts()
colors = ['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c']
ax3.pie(disorder_counts, labels=disorder_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors, explode=[0.05]*len(disorder_counts))
ax3.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution')

# 4. Heart Rate by BMI Category
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Heart Rate', ax=ax4, palette='Set2')
ax4.set_title('Heart Rate by BMI Category')
ax4.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax4.set_xlabel('BMI Category')

# 5. Daily Steps by Occupation
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
sns.barplot(data=df, x='Occupation', y='Daily Steps', ax=ax5, palette='viridis')
ax5.set_title('Daily Steps by Occupation')
ax5.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Correlation Heatmap
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
numeric_cols = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, ax=ax6, 
            fmt='.2f', square=True, linewidths=0.5)
ax6.set_title('Correlation Matrix')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
